name: Beth
source:
The alluring woman who runs the mysterious itinerant store.
Her age is indeterminate.
Beth's store pops up in different locations inside the Tower.
She handles shady merchandise and cedes products which Velt takes a liking to.
She proclaims herself the Tower's Historian and apparently records the Tower's events in some kind of diary.
